summary: Multi-agent adversarial review of the compound engineering swarm implementation plan. Five threat personas (Vortex/Resource, Paradox/Logic, Specter/Security, Entropy/Chaos, Aegis/Quality) identified 18 edge cases across critical, high, medium, and low severity. Includes concrete mitigations and architecture amendments. Grounded against live system: 306 Python files, Obsidian vault at 20M, SurrealDB status unknown, Ollama running with qwen3-coder:30b and phi4 available.
